name: Necromancer: every animated Skeletal Archer carries a bow (#5300)
contract: Animate: Skeletal Archer 805040 triggers 500330, whose authored base count is three Skeletal Archers
(creature 50076) for 15 seconds. The summons must carry bows in their ranged equipment slots, as
their archer role requires. Count bows by the runtime item's weapon class and bow subclass, without
requiring a particular item ID or display. A second nearby Necromancer owns none of these archers,
and guns must not satisfy the bow check. All three freshly animated archers must also have bows
after the original summons expire. This covers native equipment loading, not rendered animations.
The existing ranged Shadow attack 801516 is authored by Spell.dbc and is outside this equipment fix.

steps.label: The normal cast animates three archers
Every spawned archer carries a ranged bow
The archers carry no ranged guns
The nearby player does not own these archers
All fresh archers load their bows too
